finding: Physical inactivity, infrequent antenatal visits, analgesic use, and cesarean delivery were identified as significant risk factors for both new-onset and persistent postpartum preeclampsia.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with both the new-onset postpartum preeclampsia and persistent postpartum preeclampsia.
birth_weight: Low birth weight babies were significantly associated with persistent postpartum preeclampsia.
